findings.title: Fast path bypasses validation and relies solely on SameWireNode
findings.message: The fast path skips accessibilitySemantic validation, so it relies on accessibilitySameWireNode alone for exact-match. If SameWireNode ignores fields like unexported ones or nested slices by reference (aliasing owner-mutated data), the baseline could be mutated later, yet the owned nodes are not retained, so risk is limited. However, handler/guard replacement happens without the closed check after unlock ordering and without generation checks relative to concurrent updates.
findings.suggestion: Verify that SameWireNode compares slices (Actions, GridFrame) by value, and add a concurrency test for reuse racing with close/update.
